audience.text: Developers needing metadata-safe PSD/PSB inspection and limited structural editing in .NET without rendering or full Photoshop feature support.

capabilities.text: Load PSD and supported PSB files from file paths or streams using the Image.Load API.
capabilities.title: Load PSD/PSB from file or stream

capabilities.text: Read document properties including Width, Height, ChannelsCount, BitsPerChannel, ColorMode, Version, Compression, Layers, and ImageResources.
capabilities.title: Read document metadata

capabilities.text: Read and modify layer properties such as Name, Bounds, IsVisible, Opacity, Clipping, BlendModeKey, and geometry coordinates.
capabilities.title: Read and edit layer metadata

capabilities.text: Save updated PSD/PSB files without rendering pixels, preserving unsupported sections as raw bytes where possible.
capabilities.title: Save without rendering

capabilities.text: Build and test the library using standard .NET CLI commands on the provided solution file.
capabilities.title: Build and test with .NET CLI

limitations.text: Does not render PSD/PSB content or support pixel editing.
Does not export to raster formats such as PNG or JPEG.
Does not provide semantic recognition or full editing of image resources or tagged blocks.

problems_solved.text: Enables reading and editing of supported layer metadata such as name, visibility, opacity, blend mode, clipping, and geometry without rendering pixels.
Provides a compact API to inspect document properties like dimensions, color mode, version, compression, layers, and image resources.
Preserves unsupported file sections as raw bytes when saving, ensuring minimal data loss during metadata edits.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PSD.FOSS is a free open-source .NET library for loading, inspecting, editing a small subset of PSD/PSB metadata, and saving the file back without rendering.

uncertainties: Whether the package is published to NuGet or only available via local build.
Exact set of supported image resource types and their metadata exposure.
Whether PSB support is complete or partial for large documents.
How raw-byte preservation behaves for complex or nested unsupported structures.
Whether blend mode keys beyond those in the example are supported.
Whether layer mask and channel data are exposed beyond basic metadata.
Whether the library supports reading or writing text layers.
Whether adjustment layers or smart filters are supported.

workflows.name: Load and inspect PSD/PSB
workflows.text: Load a PSD/PSB file from path or stream and read document and layer metadata using the Aspose.PSD-style API.

workflows.name: Edit layer properties
workflows.text: Modify supported layer properties including name, visibility, opacity, blend mode, clipping, and geometry coordinates.

workflows.name: Save without rendering
workflows.text: Save the updated PSD/PSB file back to disk or stream without rendering pixels, preserving unsupported sections as raw bytes.
